pullRequests.title: fix(difficulty): call the NTSC-U line test by the port's name, version 1.2.2
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/difficulty-ntsc-line-test
pullRequests.body:
On the US disc the mod asked for the line test as FUN_L00_001efc70, the decomp's spelling. The port's NTSC-U build has its own C for it under func_L00_001EFC70, so the lookup failed and the mod never loaded. Also brings the library's version string in line with the manifest (both 1.2.2).
Tests pass. Not tried on a real US disc.
Fixes #1

commits.headline: fix(difficulty): call the NTSC-U line test by the port's name, version 1.2.2
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
On the US disc the mod asked for the line test as the NTSC decomp spells it, FUN_L00_001efc70, but
OpenRAC's NTSC-U build has its own C for it (rac1/host/collision.c) under func_L00_001EFC70; the
decomp's spelling only redirects calls inside the port (port/game/rac1-ntsc/no_c.tsv, "other
spelling"), so openrac_api.function gave nothing and the mod refused to load: "this disc's build
has no function FUN_L00_001efc70". The other NTSC-U names of every mod are the port's.
